description: Hermes-facing search combo. Primary path: OmniRoute combo web-search (PRIORITY). Direct adapters when Omni is unavailable.
notes: Combo name web-search — operator configures members in Omni UI.
Router Worker omni backend uses omni_combo + omni_providers fallback.
WEB_BACKENDS default omni — Omni first, then direct adapters.
Per-provider timeout WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_S keeps failover bounded.
Extract stays on Router Worker (SearXNG cannot extract).
